Subject: MonteVista onsite — welcome kits, parking & quiet-room prefs

Hi Sarah / Tom —

We're finalizing a few logistical items for the April 23–25 onsite and wanted to confirm preferences so we can lock rooming, parking passes, and welcome kits this week. Short summary of asks below — if you can respond inline that will make our logistics team's job much easier.

1) Guest preferences form — I've attached a short form that collects bed type, allergies, and quiet-room requests. Please ask each attendee to complete by next Wed (3/19). I attached a CSV template in case you want to send a consolidated list.

2) Welcome kits — proposed contents in the attached PDF. We can swap one item to a branded notebook if you prefer. Please confirm any restricted items for compliance.

3) Parking passes — how many spots do you want reserved on-site? We have daily and multi-day rates; our ops lead needs a headcount by 3/20 to reserve the lot.

4) Early arrivals / late departures — two of your execs often request early check-in. If anyone needs guaranteed early check-in or late checkout, note names and arrival times and we'll request the room block accordingly.

Attachments: guest_preferences_form.docx (form), rooming_list.csv (template), welcome_kit_items.pdf (items list)

Thanks — short replies welcome. We'll follow up with the final vendor booking once we have the list.

—Marissa

Hi Marissa —

Got it, thanks. Quick answers inline:

1) Guest preferences — I'll push the form to attendees and compile the CSV. Expect a consolidated file by Monday (3/17).

2) Welcome kits — MonteVista prefers a reusable water bottle instead of the single-use bottle on your list. Also please avoid anything with latex due to an attendee.

3) Parking — please reserve 6 multi-day passes and 2 daily passes for overflow. We'll pay any associated fees.

4) Early check-in — please hold early check-in for Sarah Collins (arrive 4/22 10:30am) and Michael Ho (arrive 4/22 08:45am). Both may need a guaranteed room by 11:00.

I'll send the attendee CSV and a note about dietary restrictions by Monday. Thanks for coordinating.

- Parking: reserving 6 multi-day + 2 daily. I'll send a billing request to finance after we confirm final headcount.
- Early check-in: I've flagged the block for early arrivals (4/22) and will request guaranteed rooms for Sarah and Michael. Hotel typically charges a small early-check-in fee; I'll confirm if we can cover it in the master bill.

I've uploaded the current rooming_list.csv to the shared ops folder and attached a copy here. Please add arrival times and bed preferences directly to the CSV; that will let us generate parking passes and welcome-kit labels in bulk.

Attachments: rooming_list.csv (current)

On another note — Laura, can you confirm whether we have 100 welcome kits in the budget line item or if we should cap at 75? Ops prefers an exact qty before ordering.
